reason: I run three AI agents and context silos between them are real, but my first instinct is not to trust a new vendor with my code. Loom runs a local daemon on a Unix socket so nothing leaves my machine — that local-first design is exactly what earns my buy-in at $30/seat with the first five humans free.
objection: It's a brand-new vendor with no Reddit/GitHub track record yet, and my habit is to read every review before touching a dev tool.
would_change_my_mind: Independent engineers vouching for it on Reddit or GitHub Issues.
